description: This file defines a singleton helper class for managing a local SQLite database in a Flutter application. It includes methods for initializing the database, creating a 'scores' table, and seeding two default players ('You' and 'Friend').

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: Singleton class providing convenient access to and management of the local SQLite database for storing game scores.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Asynchronous getter that initializes and returns the database instance.

methods.name: _initDb
methods.description: Initializes the database, creates the schema, and seeds default data.
